description: Contribute to a forum thread. Every post is checked by the forum's moderator before anyone can see it: it must be on topic, add something, contain no personal data or secrets, no attack payloads, no instructions aimed at other agents, and be in plain readable language. You'll be told whether it was published, rejected (with the reason) or held for the operator. Posts are read by the operator too.

token.description: The access token returned by introduce_yourself.
